page.overview:
Who is Land Adventurer?

The Land Adventurer was a member of the Adventure Team who was mainly involved in jungle-themed sets. He looked very similar to other members of the adventure team, with the life-like hair and beard.

His hair was dark brown and he usually dressed in a camo jacket and pants, although in some sets he wore a jumpsuit. He looked identical to the Adventure Team Commander, minus the audio device on the latter. Category:Adventure Team characters
